approaches.name: Pi-native MCP
approaches.evidence: Pi core has no built-in MCP contract or Linear-specific tool. The installed CLI only exposes provider/model/tool controls; the mcp tool appeared only after loading the optional adapter.
approaches.decision: Do not infer MCP availability from Pi installation. Return an explicit unsupported-capability error.

approaches.name: Pi MCP adapter through model tool calls
approaches.evidence: The installed pi-mcp-adapter 2.11.0 registered an mcp proxy and configured direct tools. With an isolated fixture MCP server, search returned linear_list_issues and linear_get_issue, and a direct linear_list_issues call returned bounded JSON.
approaches.limits: This is an optional extension/configuration, not a stable Pi core API. Proxy search is discovery-oriented and model-mediated; direct tool names and schemas must be preflighted. No configured server produced no matching Linear tools.
approaches.decision: Accept only as an explicitly configured capability with a static direct-tool allowlist and schema validation. Never auto-install, auto-adopt host configs, or silently use another runtime.

approaches.name: Dedicated read-only helper
approaches.evidence: A helper can speak the configured Linear API or MCP server directly and return schema-bound JSON without spending a Pi model turn or trusting model-generated discovery text.
approaches.limits: No helper is part of this spike or the current repository. It must be supplied and configured separately.
approaches.decision: Keep Pi worker execution and Linear discovery separate. Use this seam when implementation ticket 03 supplies a helper capability; otherwise report discovery unsupported.

nonNegotiable: The Pi adapter must not fall back to Claude or Codex discovery commands.
